narrative.overview: The portfolio is a quiet instrument panel for a backend engineer. Every surface reads as machined hardware against deep space: flat near-black and navy planes, crisp 2px slate borders, serif headings set like engraved labels, and a single diffuse white-glow halo that behaves like the console's only illumination. The physics-based Event Horizon black hole is the lens the whole system looks through — the artifact leads, the interface recedes. The atmosphere is deliberate and minimal. Whitespace and restraint carry as much signal as the glow; nothing pulses for attention beyond the hero. Depth comes from the white halo and a fine grain overlay, never from soft gray shadows or gradients. The monochrome commitment is total: accent color is treated as a scarce resource, reserved for rare warm/cool glows that read as telemetry, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome instrument UI: black + near-black blue surfaces, white text, slate borders
The white-glow halo is the signature depth and accent move
Flat dark fills by default; 2px slate borders define containment
Serif headlines over a variable humanist sans body
A WebGL black-hole simulation is the single hero artifact
Small radii (6-8px) and 2px borders make controls feel machined

rules.name: The Glow Rule
rules.body: The white halo is the only light source. Soft gray shadows and colored gradients are banned; depth is flat fills plus the halo.

rules.name: The Ember Rarity Rule
rules.body: Ember Oxide and Abyss Blue appear only as rare accent glows. If either covers more than ~5% of a screen, it is no longer telemetry.

rules.name: The Slate Line Rule
rules.body: Containment is a 2px Halo Slate border or flat separation, never a tinted panel.

rules.name: The Serif Headline Rule
rules.body: Every heading is DM Serif Text. Mona Sans is body-only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the halo appears only on interactive elements and the title pill, never as a resting backdrop.

dos: Do keep surfaces flat dark fills; let the white-glow halo supply lift on interactive elements only.
Do use 2px Halo Slate borders for containment on cards, tags, inputs, and outline buttons.
Do set every heading in DM Serif Text and every body paragraph in Mona Sans.
Do use rounded-md (6px) as the default corner; reserve rounded-full for interactive points.
Do treat the Event Horizon as the single hero artifact and keep competing hero animations out.
Do keep accent colors below ~5% of any screen.
donts: Don't use soft gray box shadows or gradients for depth; the halo is the only shadow vocabulary.
Don't introduce pastels, colored fills, or a second accent family into the monochrome system.
Don't lift the background with tinted panels; separate with borders and tonal recess instead.
Don't replace small-radius machined forms with large-radius soft-UI surfaces (the title pill is the exception).
Don't let animation out-pulse the hero: entrance fades, the marquee, and the typed name are the ceiling.
